title: Fitra (Vanilla Infused Olive Oil)
desc: "YI strongly wanted every part of her life to align with Islam and natural living. She decided to ask her mother what her grandmother would use on her skin before beauty products became mainstream. Her answer: olive oil. She already knew that olive oil had significance in Islam. Her only problem: she wasn’t a fan of the smell. She experimented, and being a vanilla lover, she created vanilla-infused olive oil. She used the product herself and shared it with family. “My dad isn’t a fan of products, but he actually started using it,” she stated. She wanted to share her creation; she began gifting it to friends and family. Soon she realized she wanted to continue to share the product and make it a brand. That’s when FTRA was born."
